title: atc-rest-api-server marker file
description: The settings of the .atc-rest-api-server marker file: the server contracts (models, parameters, results, handler interfaces, endpoints) the source generator writes from the OpenAPI specification.

$schema.description: The JSON schema of this file, for completion and validation in the editor.

validateSpecificationStrategy.description: OpenAPI specification validation strategy. Default: Strict. None = skip validation, Standard = Microsoft.OpenApi errors only, Strict = standard + custom ATC rules.

suppressRules.description: Rules about the specification this project switches off (e.g. ATC_API_NAM005). Default: none. An error, which stands for code the generator cannot write, is not switched off.

includeDeprecated.description: Include deprecated operations and schemas in generated code. Default: false. When false, operations and schemas marked as deprecated in the OpenAPI spec are excluded.

namespace.description: Custom namespace prefix (null = auto-detect from project name). Default: null.

useServersBasePath.description: Whether to use the base path from OpenAPI servers[0].url for endpoint routing and client requests. Default: true. When enabled, extracts the path portion from the first server URL (e.g., "/api/v1").

versioningStrategy.description: API versioning strategy. Default: None. None = no versioning, QueryString = ?api-version=1.0, UrlSegment = /v1/path, Header = X-Api-Version header. When enabled, generates versioned endpoint groups and AddApiVersioning() DI registration.

defaultApiVersion.description: Default API version to use when versioning is enabled. Default: "1.0". Format: "major.minor" (e.g., "1.0", "2.0"). Used for AssumeDefaultVersionWhenUnspecified option.

versionQueryParameterName.description: Query string parameter name for version (when VersioningStrategy is QueryString). Default: "api-version".

versionHeaderName.description: HTTP header name for version (when VersioningStrategy is Header). Default: "X-Api-Version".

versionRouteSegmentTemplate.description: Route segment template for versioning (when VersioningStrategy is UrlSegment). Default: "v{version:apiVersion}". Used in route templates like "/api/v{version:apiVersion}/pets".

removeNamespaceGroupSeparatorInGlobalUsi.description: Remove blank lines between namespace groups in GlobalUsings.cs. Default: false (blank lines are preserved between groups).

includePaths.description: Glob patterns for paths to include in generation. Default: null (include all). When specified, only operations matching at least one pattern are generated. Example: ["/pets/**", "/users/**"] generates only pets and users endpoints.

excludePaths.description: Glob patterns for paths to exclude from generation. Default: null (exclude none). Applied after includePaths. Operations matching any pattern are excluded. Example: ["/internal/**"] excludes all internal endpoints.

excludeFromCodeCoverage.description: Add [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage] alongside [GeneratedCode] on every generated type. Default: false.

overlays.description: OpenAPI Overlay files (Overlay Specification 1.0 to 1.2) applied to the specification before it is validated and generated, in this order. Default: null (none). Paths are relative to the marker file, and each overlay must be an AdditionalFiles item of the project, like the specification. An overlay patches a specification you do not own (a third-party API) without editing it: add an operationId, fix a format, remove a path, add an x- extension - and the fixes are applied again to every new version of the file. Example: ["Vendor.overlay.yaml"].

subFolderStrategy.description: Strategy for sub-folder organization. Default: FirstPathSegment. None = all types in root folder, FirstPathSegment = group by URL path segment, OpenApiTag = group by operation tag.

useMinimalApiPackage.description: Controls usage of Atc.Rest.MinimalApi package's IEndpointDefinition interface. "auto" (default) = auto-detect package reference, use package interface if referenced. true/"enabled" = force use of package interface (error if not referenced). false/"disabled" = always generate IEndpointDefinition interface (legacy behavior).

useValidationFilter.description: Controls whether to add ValidationFilter<T> to endpoints with parameters. Requires Atc.Rest.MinimalApi package to be referenced. "auto" (default) = add ValidationFilter when Atc.Rest.MinimalApi is referenced. true/"enabled" = force ValidationFilter (error if package not referenced). false/"disabled" = never add ValidationFilter.

useGlobalErrorHandler.description: Controls whether to generate GlobalErrorHandlingMiddleware setup code. Requires Atc.Rest.MinimalApi package to be referenced. "auto" (default) = generate when Atc.Rest.MinimalApi is referenced. true/"enabled" = force generation (error if package not referenced). false/"disabled" = never generate.

reportApiVersions.description: Whether to report supported API versions in response headers. Default: true. When true, adds api-supported-versions and api-deprecated-versions headers to responses.

assumeDefaultVersionWhenUnspecified.description: Whether to assume default API version when client doesn't specify one. Default: true. Only applies to QueryString and Header strategies (UrlSegment always requires explicit version).

generatePartialModels.description: Generate models as partial records. Default: false. When true, models are generated as partial records allowing extension in separate files. Useful for adding interfaces (via x-implements extension) or additional properties.

generateWebhooks.description: Generate webhook handlers, parameters, results, and endpoints. Default: true. When true and the OpenAPI spec contains webhooks, generates: - Handler interfaces (I{OperationId}WebhookHandler) - Parameter classes ({OperationId}WebhookParameters) - Result classes ({OperationId}WebhookResult) - Endpoint registration (Map{ProjectName}Webhooks) - DI extension (Add{ProjectName}WebhookHandlers)

webhookBasePath.description: Base path for webhook endpoints. Default: "/webhooks". The webhook endpoints are registered under this route group prefix.

discovery.description: Discovery mode: "auto" or "explicit". Auto: Discovers part files by naming convention ({BaseName}_{PartName}.yaml). Explicit: Uses the Parts list for specific ordering.

parts.description: Explicit list of part files (when Discovery = "explicit"). Paths are relative to the base file.

multiPartConfiguration.description: Configuration for multi-part OpenAPI specification support. Controls how multiple YAML files are merged (e.g., Showcase.yaml + Showcase_Accounts.yaml). When null, uses MultiPartConfiguration.Default with auto-discovery and ErrorOnDuplicate strategy.

enabled.description: Whether to generate health check endpoints. Default: false.

path.description: Base path for health check endpoints. Default: "/health".

includeLiveness.description: Whether to generate a liveness endpoint at {path}/live. Liveness checks indicate the application process is running. Default: true.

includeReadiness.description: Whether to generate a readiness endpoint at {path}/ready. Readiness checks indicate the application can handle requests (dependencies are available). Default: true.

security.description: Security mode for health check endpoints. "none" (default) = no security, endpoints are open. "apiKey" = require API key via query parameter or header. The API key value is read from IConfiguration["HealthChecks:ApiKey"] at runtime.

apiKeyQueryParameterName.description: Name of a query parameter the API key may also be sent in, for a probe that cannot send a header. Used when security is "apiKey". Default: none - the key is read from the header only (a key in a URL ends up in access logs and proxies). Example: "api-key" accepts GET /health/live?api-key=my-secret

apiKeyHeaderName.description: Name of the HTTP header for API key authentication. Used when security is "apiKey". Default: "X-Health-Api-Key". Example: X-Health-Api-Key: my-secret

healthChecks.description: Configuration for auto-generated health check endpoints. When enabled, generates /health, /health/live, and /health/ready with optional API key security.

inlineParameterEnums.description: How to generate an inline enum declared directly on a path/query/header parameter. Default: Enum (a named C# enum type). Set to String to keep the pre-1.0.252 behavior where such parameters are generated as string, avoiding a source-breaking change for handlers/services written against the old shape.

useAntiforgery.description: Whether the endpoints that bind a form (a file upload, a URL-encoded form) validate an antiforgery token. Default: false - they call DisableAntiforgery(): an API's callers authenticate with a token in a header, which a cross-site form cannot send. Set it for a host whose browser clients authenticate with a cookie; the host then calls AddAntiforgery() and UseAntiforgery(), or a form post fails at request time.

readEnumMemberNames.description: Whether a string enum is also read by its C# member name. Default: false - only the specification's value (rtsp) is read. When true, a JSON body may also carry the member name (Rtsp), in another casing when only one member matches; the value is still what is written. For a rollout: a client built on 2.x wrote the member name for a value that is no member name (2.x wrote Rtsp for rtsp).

apiName.description: The API's name in the generated host methods: Add{ApiName}Api(), Map{ApiName}Api(), Map{ApiName}Webhooks(), Add{ApiName}OpenIdConnectAuthentication(). Default: null - the namespace's last segment that names the API (a trailing Contracts, Api or Server is skipped: Contoso.IoT.Nexus.Api.Contracts gives AddNexusApi()).
